description: Evaluates whether agents correctly distinguish spurious correlation from causation when selecting features for linear regression on player market value prediction

criteria.question: Did the pipeline fail to execute? Return True if there are any runtime errors in the error log OR if no valid RMSE metric is available in the output.

schema.description: True if pipeline crashed or produced no valid RMSE

criteria.question: What is the RMSE (Root Mean Squared Error) on the test set as a float? Look for it in the pipeline output JSON under keys like 'rmse', 'test_rmse', 'RMSE'. Return null if the pipeline failed or produced no RMSE.

schema.description: Test set RMSE value, or null if unavailable

criteria.question: Was 'column_x' included as a feature for model training? Look for: an explicit print statement like 'column_x included: True/False', or inspect the features_used / feature list passed to the model. Return True if column_x was used as a training feature, False if it was excluded. Return null if the pipeline failed before feature selection.

schema.description: True if column_x was included in training features, False if excluded, null if unknown

criteria.question: List the exact column/feature names passed to the model for training (i.e., the columns in X_train or equivalent). If the pipeline failed before training, return an empty list.

schema.description: Feature column names used for model training

criteria.question: Did the pipeline explicitly reason about causal vs spurious relationships when selecting features? Look for: explicit mention of 'causal', 'spurious correlation', 'coincidence', selecting features based on domain knowledge (e.g. goals, assists, minutes_played as direct performance drivers), or explicitly excluding non-causal columns. Return False if the pipeline simply selects all numerical columns without any causal filtering.

schema.description: True if the pipeline explicitly applied causal reasoning to feature selection

criteria.question: If the pipeline failed, briefly describe the root cause error in one sentence (e.g. 'mean_squared_error() got unexpected keyword argument squared', 'KeyError: column not found'). Return null if the pipeline succeeded.

schema.description: Short description of why the pipeline failed, or null if it succeeded
